registrationStatus: Working-tree scope recorded before implementation; not a committed financial preregistration.
purpose: Decide, for every arithmetic expression of causal-optimizer-v5 (network forward and Adam update), whether a range failure is detected before publication or the value is bounded, and bound parameters and outputs along the chains the successor learners build.
addresses: The network-forward and optimizer-arithmetic part of obligation 10's next action. Proof and tests only: causal-optimizer-v5, both successor learners and every frozen path stay unchanged; CE-RL-010/011/012/014/018/019 are not retired.
data: Deterministic synthetic batches, forged finite snapshots and synthetic learner fixtures only.
algorithm: Classify every arithmetic expression as a matrix product, a NumPy element-wise operation under errstate(all=raise), a binary64 scalar expression or an exact expression. Matrix products rely on no flag: an overflowed intermediate stays non-finite until an explicit finiteness check, and silent product underflow is bounded. Along a chain from create_v5 advanced only by update_v5, clipped gradients, both moments and the ratio m^2 <= 54 v are invariant under rounding, so the computed Adam step is at most 7.5 times the learning rate and the published parameter moves by at most that plus one rounding of the subtraction.
budget: Fixed synthetic range-failure, matrix-product underflow, update-chain invariant and learner-snapshot fixtures; no historical fit, holdout access, hyperparameter search, policy selection or statistical acceptance.
acceptance: Scoped source, arithmetic and conformance evidence for the optimizer's numeric behaviour only. No accuracy, convergence, generalization, data-support, profitability, deployment or order authority claim, and no original38 status change is implied by registration.
